findings.title: Sesin ve suyun iki kez aşağıda konumlanması, en düşük yeri kederden kaçılacak nokta değil, teselli ve rızkın geldiği yer hâline çevirir.
findings.claim: The focus's two below-position phrases can carry a spatial reversal in which the low place around Mary becomes the place where an answering voice and flowing provision reach her.
findings.mechanism: The repeated تَحْت carrier is attached first to the directed call and then to the Lord's completed placement; the focus grief word and final stream word contact that repeated below-space. The supplied 25:10 rivers-beneath-gardens image, 41:30 reassurance against fear and grief, and 37:104 direct-call scene provide separate wider triggers, changing below from a merely low coordinate into a reachable site of consolation and sustenance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can keep the ordinary scene of a call and a stream in view while perceiving the low space itself as the route by which reassurance and provision arrive.
findings.containment: This is a bounded spatial and contextual resonance. It preserves the ordinary below-location, grief, call, and stream readings; it does not activate social inferiority, identify the caller, or claim that the wider scenes share the same narrative setting.

epistemic.reason: The candidate support supplies exact focus anchors for all four branches, and the cited connection rows supply exact external Arabic for distinct call, reassurance, and below-flow triggers. Their missing target morphology remains outside the claim.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Cekirdek anlam, yukarinin karsiti olan alt konumdur.
branch_activations.carrier: The two focus occurrences of تَحْت place the call below her and the gift below you.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 25:10 supplies the separate image of rivers running beneath gardens.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated below-position carrier meets the wider below-flow provision image, so the low coordinate becomes an accessible source of care within this ayah.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The beneath-space is heard as the place from which consolation and provision reach Mary.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation preserves a spatial relation and does not activate the social-inferiority branch of تَحْت.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel durum, iç sıkıntısının kişide oluşturduğu ağır üzüntüdür ve sevinçle karşıtlık içindedir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus prohibition addresses Mary's continuing grief through تَحْزَنِي.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 41:30 supplies a separate reassurance joining release from fear and grief with good news.
branch_activations.activation: The focus grief command meets that wider reassurance, making the prohibition part of a movement from distress toward received good news while remaining an address to Mary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The relief from grief is heard as an active transition into consolation rather than only an instruction to stop feeling sad.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains the emotional grief field; it does not import the terrain, animal, or kinship branches.

findings.title: Aşağıdaki akış, maddi suyun yanında onur veren bir rahatlama çağrışımını da taşıyabilir.
findings.claim: Alongside its material-water sense, the focus's repeated below-position and final سَرِيّ can let the provision be heard as relief carrying an honor-bearing force.
findings.mechanism: The تَحْت carrier meets 25:10's rivers beneath gardens, while 3:45 supplies a separate status trigger in its supplied announcement of Jesus to Mary, including the descriptions وَجِيهًا and مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ. That status signal contacts the honor facet of the focus's final سَرِيّ without removing the stream construction, so the flow can carry dignity as well as material relief.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the water plainly present and can also perceive the gift as reaching a woman under pressure with a dignity-bearing force.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual resonance, not a replacement referent. It does not settle the stream and noble-person pressures into one lexical verdict, and it does not claim target morphology or lexical analysis for 3:45 beyond the supplied Arabic.

epistemic.reason: The candidate support is trusted but marked weak; the exact focus anchor and independent 3:45 status trigger support retaining the honor facet, while the external row's missing target morphology remains explicit.

branch_activations.boundary: The spatial below facet remains primary here; social inferiority and any fixed garden setting are outside the claim.
